name: Tactical Electric
about:
Tactical Electric operates as Tactical Contractors Inc. from its base in New York City, serving all five boroughs with a focus on Downtown Manhattan neighborhoods such as the Financial District, Tribeca, SoHo, Chelsea, and the West Village. The company does not disclose a founding year or founder names in its public materials, describing its tenure only as "a long time" and emphasizing years of experience among its licensed electricians.

The firm provides residential and commercial electrical contracting services, including full rewiring, panel upgrades and repairs, sub-panel installations, lighting design and installation (recessed, track, accent, bathroom, kitchen, dimming systems), troubleshooting, safety inspections, dedicated circuitry for home offices, and outlet installation. It offers 24/7 emergency response and same-day service for urgent issues. No facility size, headcount, or project volume figures are published.

Customers range from apartment and brownstone owners in historic districts to commercial tenants in Midtown and the Financial District. The company works with general contractors on pre-renovation inspections and punch lists, and serves property managers handling lease turnovers. Specific neighborhoods cited include Gramercy, Flatiron, Nolita, the Upper East and West Sides, Battery Park, and the Lower East Side.

Tactical Electric positions itself on professionalism, reliability, and affordability, highlighting clear communication, upfront pricing, and a policy of returning to complete repairs free of charge if an issue is not resolved on the first visit. Its electricians are licensed and insured, and the company stresses safety-first practices such as whole-house surge protection, GFCI and AFCI compliance, and childproof outlets.
built_on: Licensed and insured electricians on every job
Free return visits if repairs not resolved on first attempt
Upfront pricing with no hidden fees
capabilities: Electrical safety inspections (load testing, GFCI/AFCI checks)
type_evidence: Our licensed residential electricians put safety and quality first—handling everything from lighting upgrades and dimming systems to full rewires and emergency repairs.
